lines: How do noise-cancelling headphones make the world go quiet?
Plot twist... they actually add more sound!
Tiny mics on the outside listen to the noise around you, all the time.
Then a chip makes the exact opposite sound wave, and the two cancel out. Silence!
It works best on steady hums, like plane engines... but voices sneak through.
That's why you can still hear someone calling your name. Busted!
